details.title: Project Overview
details.body:
Veer Forma is an AI-native platform that transforms ideas into professional, editable knowledge artifacts.

Unlike traditional AI tools that generate static text or images, Forma understands the semantic structure of documents, presentations, diagrams, charts, and visual systems, enabling AI to create artifacts that remain fully editable in their native applications.

details.title: Vision
details.body: Enable anyone to transform ideas into professional-quality, editable knowledge artifacts through AI.

details.title: Mission
details.body:
Build the world's most intelligent platform for engineering knowledge.

---

details.title: 📄 AI Document Engineering
details.body:
Generate professional:

* Word documents
* Technical specifications
* Whitepapers
* Research papers
* Reports
* Proposals
* Manuals
* Training material

---

details.title: 📊 AI Presentation Engineering
details.body:
Create enterprise-grade PowerPoint presentations with:

* Intelligent layouts
* Professional typography
* Speaker notes
* Animations
* Native PowerPoint objects

---

details.title: 🏗 AI Diagram Engineering
details.body:
Generate editable diagrams including:

* Flowcharts
* UML
* BPMN
* ER Models
* C4 Architecture
* Cloud Architecture
* Kubernetes
* Network Topology
* Sequence Diagrams
* Organizational Charts
* Mind Maps
* Timelines
